title: Identify review papers and critical studies that analyse the current state of the art in prosthetic or assistive product design, focusing on limitations, gaps, and unresolved challenges across design methods, customization, accessibility, and user involvement. Look for literature that explicitly highlights research gaps, contradictions, or unmet needs. Prioritise systematic reviews, meta-analyses, or discussion papers that support critical synthesis rather than purely technical solutions.
